subject: Post-demo: buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking time today — great discussion and appreciate the full buying committee joining. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward your timeline.

Attendees (from your side):
- Raj Patel (CTO / economic buyer)
- Samantha Ortiz (Dir. Product)
- Several engineering leads and a procurement observer

Key takeaways / decision criteria (as heard today):
- Accuracy & hallucination mitigation on clinical content is top priority (Samantha)
- Latency under 350ms p50 for interactive workflows (Raj)
- Predictable cost at scale and good unit economics for batch jobs
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 type II, data residency controls, and contractual DPA

Stakeholder mapping / process: 
- Economic buyer: Raj Patel (confirms procurement & legal involvement next)
- Security/legal: will need SOC 2 report, data flow diagrams, and DPA review (you flagged Legal)
- Procurement: PO process + certs for insurance; procurement contact to be looped in by Raj

Proposed next steps (owners & timing):
1) Shared mutual action plan & SLA draft (attached) — action: Marissa to send updated MAP/SLA by EOD today (Nov 9) [done, attached: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, SLA_Draft_v2.pdf]
2) Procurement packet: insurance certs, PO form, payment terms — action: Acme procurement to confirm PO timeline; Redwood will provide examples
3) Security artifacts: SOC 2 report + data retention and access controls doc — action: Marissa to share SOC 2 link; Redwood security contact available for a call if Legal requests deeper review
4) Pricing & pilot options: Dev to propose pilot scope + pricing proposal by Nov 12 — action: Dev Patel
5) Follow-up meeting with key stakeholders (Raj, Samantha, Legal, Procurement, Redwood leads) — proposed window: Tue Nov 16 or Wed Nov 17.

Please confirm the procurement contact and preferred follow-up date/time. If any of the decision criteria above are misstated, flag and I'll update the MAP.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), SLA_Draft_v2.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — good capture. Confirming: I will be the economic buyer and will drive procurement/PO on our side. Please loop in our procurement and legal teams (procurement@acmehealth.com, legal@acmehealth.com).

Timeline: we are aiming to complete evaluation and have a contract in place by the end of November if everything checks out. That assumes we can quickly get SOC 2 and DPA review completed and we have a reasonable pilot/pricing.

For pricing: can Dev send a short pilot proposal (3-week pilot, up to 10k tokens/day equivalent) and the estimated cost and any ramp/expansion pricing? Also include options for on-prem/private deployment vs hosted (if there are material differences in SLA/cost).

Raj
CTO, Acme Health

Hi Marissa / Raj — procurement here. Thanks for the recap. A few items we need to proceed: 
- Completed PO form (attached: Acme_PO_Form.pdf)
- Certificate of insurance (COI) and vendor W9
- SOC 2 type II report and any penetration testing summaries
- Standard vendor terms: liability caps, data processing addendum

Can Redwood provide a one-page summary of the pilot pricing and the standard commercial terms you expect? Also confirm estimated invoice lead time after PO approval. We generally require net 45 for vendors of this size but can discuss.

Procurement Team

Appreciate the fast response — happy to get everything over. Quick commitments from our side: 
- SOC 2 type II report: link to our security portal provided here: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2 (we will also attach the cert in the packet)
- DPA & standard terms: attached SLA_Draft_v2.pdf; we can surface Redwood legal for a sync if Legal wants deeper review
- COI & W9: I will collect and send to procurement by COB today
- Pilot pricing proposal: Dev will send a one-page pilot scope + cost estimate by Thu Nov 12 (Dev: can you confirm?)
- Invoice/payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 30; we can be flexible but will confirm with finance when we see PO

Next steps / owners:
- Marissa: update MAP and send final attachments (today) — DONE
- Dev Patel: pilot scope + pricing (by Nov 12) — ASSIGNED
- Redwood Security: available for legal Q&A (Marissa to coordinate)
- Follow-up meeting: propose Tue Nov 16 @ 10am PT — please confirm availability

If everyone is aligned I'll go ahead and schedule the follow-up and include Redwood’s security and solutions architects.

Thanks,
Marissa
